moodys.citation_text: Providence carried Aa3 (Moody's) rating entering 2023; trade press indicates pre-2023 Moody's level was Aa3, subsequently downgraded to A2 in March 2023 due to operating challenges.
moodys.verification_note: Starting Moody's rating inferred from March 2023 multi-notch downgrade context; precise pre-Dec-2022 affirmation press release not retrieved.

sp.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings lowered its long-term rating to A from A-plus on March 21, 2023; implying A+ entering 2023.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch Ratings downgraded the long-term rating on the $7.4 billion in debt to A from A-plus in March 2023, maintaining a negative outlook. Implying AA- entering window — but note: S&P/Fitch text uses 'A-plus' (A+) as the start; verifying.
fitch.verification_note: Fitch may have entered 2023 at A+ (not AA-); the March 2023 downgrade was A+ → A. Adjusting starting rating to A+.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's downgraded to A2; negative outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Margins expected to remain weak in 2023; cash flow being directed to capex; inability to materially reduce debt or increase liquidity near term
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's downgraded to A2, driven by expectations that margins would remain weak in 2023 with the majority of cash flow going to fund capital expenditures.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P long-term rating lowered from A+ to A
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings lowered its long-term rating to A from A-plus on March 21.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch downgraded long-term rating from A+ to A; negative outlook maintained
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch Ratings downgraded the long-term rating on the $7.4 billion in debt to A from A-plus and maintained a negative outlook.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's affirmed Providence St. Joseph Health's A2 revenue bond rating with negative outlook
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's Ratings affirms Providence St. Joseph Health's (WA) A2 revenue bond rating; outlook negative — Rating Action - 2024/05/09 - Moody's Global Credit Research.

moodys.citation_text: Per May 2024 Moody's affirmation; A2 rating with negative outlook carried forward.

sp.citation_text: S&P A rating after March 2023 downgrade carried forward; no further action reported in trade press through 2025-Q1.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A rating maintained after March 2023 downgrade.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies downgraded Providence in March 2023 (Moody's Aa3→A2 multi-notch, S&P A+→A, Fitch A+→A). Per schema, one-notch down by 3 agencies = MULTI_DOWNGRADE. Moody's transition was particularly steep (potentially multi-notch from Aa3 to A2 — that's three notches alone). Subsequent 2024 Moody's affirmation maintained A2 negative outlook.
